objective: Add custom storefront banner and offer/discount controls in merchant Settings
acceptance_criteria: Settings edits banner image/copy/offer and optional 0-100 percent store-wide product discount
All six themes render saved content and offers without losing them on theme switches
Server calculates discounts on product subtotal only, including variants, with deterministic rounding
Quote, cart, checkout, stored order, tracking and retries agree; changes reject stale quotes
Invalid settings and cross-tenant mutations fail; banner/content save atomically
PostgreSQL regressions, browser workflows, production build and local stack checks pass
